title: A Minimal ReLU Classifier on Non-Linearly Separable Data: Convergence and Implicit Bias at and beyond the Edge of Stability
abstract: arXiv:2610.23007v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Gradient descent (GD) with large learning rates can successfully optimize neural networks even though classical smoothness-based learning rate conditions are violated. Yet theory for this regime largely covers linear models or linearly separable data. We analyze a minimal setting outside both regimes. Specifically, a two-neuron ReLU network trained with logistic loss on 1D non-linearly separable data. The objective is nonconvex and nonsmooth, and GD exhibits edge-of-stability (EoS) behavior. We identify an active cone in parameter space that contains every perfect classifier, where the problem becomes piecewise logistic regression with a varying effective dataset. Within this cone, we prove a finite-time loss bound for constant learning rates and show that GD converges in direction to an explicit max-margin vector, while the orthogonal component converges to the unique minimizer of a non-strongly convex potential. translated_title: 非线性可分数据上的极简ReLU分类器：稳定性边缘及其之外的收敛性与隐式偏置
translated_abstract: 即使违反了经典的基于平滑性的学习率条件，采用大学习率的梯度下降（GD）仍能成功地优化神经网络。然而，针对这一情形的理论研究大多局限于线性模型或线性可分数据。我们分析了同时超出这两种情形的一个极简设置：具体而言，是在一维非线性可分数据上用逻辑损失训练的双神经元ReLU网络。该目标函数非凸且非光滑，且GD表现出稳定性边缘（EoS）行为。我们识别出参数空间中的一个活跃锥，它包含所有完美分类器；在该锥内，问题转化为具有变化有效数据集的分段逻辑回归。在该锥内，我们针对恒定学习率证明了有限时间损失上界，并证明GD在方向上收敛到一个显式的最大间隔向量，而其正交分量则收敛到一个非强凸势函数的唯一极小值点。我们进一步建立了（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文在一个极简的非凸非光滑设置（双神经元ReLU网络在一维非线性可分数据上以逻辑损失训练）中，对大学习率下梯度下降的稳定性边缘行为给出了严格理论分析，证明了有限时间损失界，并刻画了GD方向上收敛至显式最大间隔向量这一隐式偏置。
en_tdlr: This paper rigorously analyzes edge-of-stability behavior of gradient descent in a minimal nonconvex, nonsmooth setting—a two-neuron ReLU network trained with logistic loss on 1D non-linearly separable data—proving finite-time loss bounds and characterizing the implicit bias whereby GD converges in direction to an explicit max-margin vector.
